gaps.sentence: Not once ___ the defendant change his statement.
gaps.explanation: Not once has he changed… — emphatic negative with present perfect.

gaps.sentence: So widespread ___ the outage that servers abroad noticed.
gaps.explanation: So widespread was the outage that… — inversion.

gaps.sentence: Should you ___ any problems, call reception immediately.
gaps.explanation: Should you experience… = If you experience… — formal conditional inversion.

gaps.sentence: ___ you stands the man responsible for the discovery.
gaps.explanation: Dramatic inversion: 'Before you stands the man…' — the phrase of place is fronted and the verb precedes the subject.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: Barely ___ the survey published when the complaints arrived.
gaps.explanation: Barely had X happened when Y — like hardly… when.

gaps.sentence: Try ___ she might, she couldn't restart the engine.
gaps.explanation: 'Try as somebody might' — fixed concessive inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.
